verdict.rationale: The core Daily notes plugin opens a note for today's date, or creates it if it doesn't exist, and a community user confirms daily notes as a journaling workflow. The core Templates plugin provides pre-defined text, but the evidence never shows Daily notes applying a template automatically. missing for 10: explicit evidence that daily notes are pre-filled from a configured template, evidence that the daily note opens automatically on startup as the default landing place, independent hands-on corroboration of the template-plus-daily-note workflow.
